name: Pork Thai Green Curry with Zucchini Noodles, Basil & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 jalapeño pepper
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger, shallot, and garlic. Place all three in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Add to the bowl with the ginger, shallot, and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, zest lime into the small bowl. (Reserve lime for later use).
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger-jalapeño mixture, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and spices. Cook, stirring frequently until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tsp brown sugar
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and coconut milk to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
190 ml coconut milk

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems, then pick basil leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the pot (reserving a small handful of each for serving), then stir to combine.
Using a hand blender, purée the curry until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return curry to the pot.)
Slice pork chops crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pot with the curry and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through, 5-6 minutes more.
When the pork is done, add the zucchini noodles to the pot. Gently toss the noodles to coat with the curry, and continue to cook, until zucchini noodles are soft, 1-2 minutes more.
Juice reserved lime into the pot, then add fish sauce and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork green curry and zucchini noodles between bowls. Top with reserved herbs and enjoy!
